description:
Handoff ticket vectors shared by nginx (luajit) and the Cloudflare Worker (E-396). payload = the fields joined by 
 in this order: nwu1, kind, exp, ip, host, path, nonce. Each test builds the token at run time: token = base64url(payload) + '.' + base64url(HMAC-SHA1(secret, payload)), base64url without padding; the secret is used as its literal string bytes. No signed token is stored here.

vectors.name: response ticket, IPv4, path with query
request ticket, IPv6, mixed-case host, percent-encoded path
